review.notes: All 18 physical pages scanned with a 5-gram PDF-text-to-OCR word-coverage pass; remaining diffs are hyphenated contributor names (Federmann, Bjorn Karlsson etc. wrap inside the narrow contributors table) and CJK text, both faithful. The single code fence (Table 1 prompt templates, OCR lines 80-92) is balanced and its content was compared against the rendered Table 1 on physical p.4. Heading hierarchy matches the printed sections; the contributor roster and reference list have no dropped entries. Note: the PDF itself prints backslashes in the display DOI 10.1162/TACL\_A\_00730, so that OCR text is correct as-is.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.13 (Many-shot In-context Learning reference) and p.18 (MMLU-Pro reference) both print the typewriter URL http://papers.nips.cc/paper_files/paper/... with a real underscore (verified at 400-500 dpi); OCR inserted Markdown escapes at both occurrences.

Rendered physical p.15 Salute-the-classic reference prints the typewriter URL https://doi.org/10.1162/tacl_a_00730 with a real underscore; OCR inserted escapes in the URL. The printed display DOI 10.1162/TACL\_A\_00730 in the same reference literally prints backslashes in the PDF, so the OCR transcription of the display DOI is kept unchanged.
Rendered physical p.18 MMLU-Pro reference prints ...-Abstract-Datasets_and_Benchmarks_Track.html with real underscores at 500 dpi; OCR inserted Markdown escapes.

Rendered physical p.4 Table 1 prints 'Translate the following segment into <target_language>, without additional explanation.' with a space after 'into'; OCR dropped the space. The Chinese ZH<=>XX template above was compared glyph-by-glyph and matches.
